module com_1bit(
    input B,
    input Comin,
    output Bout,
    output Comout
);

    assign Bout = B ^ Comin;
    assign Comout = (B ^ Comin) | Comin;

endmodule

module FA_1bit(
    input A,
    input B,
    input Cin,
    output S,
    output Cout
);

    assign S = A ^ B ^ Cin;
    assign Cout = (A & B) | (Cin & B) | (Cin & A);

endmodule
